chunks: "Whatever you miss during the night, make it up during the day.
Allah, Blessed and Exalted, said: 'And it is He who made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.'

key_terms.خِلْفَةً: in succession, alternating one after the other
key_terms.فَاتَكَ: what escaped or was missed by you
key_terms.فَاقْضِهِ: then make it up or perform it as qada'

ai.seo_question: Can missed night worship be made up during the day in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: The hadith teaches that acts of worship missed during the night may be made up during the day. It supports this ruling by citing the Qur'anic idea that Allah made night and day alternate, allowing opportunities for remembrance and gratitude to continue.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1425 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whatever you miss during the night, make it up during the day,
as Allah (swt) the Exalted said: 'And it is He who made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.'
